🛠️ Desaign 的 Z-Image Turbo 工作流程 — ZIT_Gamma 发布

的设计ZIT_Gamma发布介绍了我们 Z-Image Turbo 工作流程的最新发展，旨在推动摄影真实感、连贯性和渲染稳定性甚至更进一步，同时保持定义 ZIT 管道的简单性和速度。

该版本集成了重新设计的采样策略、更新的渲染架构和新的基础模型，使 ZIT_Gamma 成为迄今为止最精致且以摄影为中心的工作流程版本。

工作流程仍然存在快速、干净、连贯且可靠，同时操作起来仍然非常简单。它同样适用于快速探索一代、编辑摄影、电影图像和高质量的视觉制作。

🔄 概述

设计ZIT_伽玛是围绕两个主要渲染通道.

1. 第一遍 — 生成 (TXT2IMG / IMG2IMG)

第一遍作为图像的创作基础。

您可以：

• 直接从文本生成 (TXT2IMG)
• 变换现有图像，同时保留结构 (IMG2IMG)

在此版本中，重新设计了第一遍的采样策略提供更强大的全局组合、更稳定的解剖结构和改进的 LoRA 兼容性。

2. 第二遍——细化

第二遍执行图像的受控重新解释，加强：

• 纹理密度
• 灯光真实感
• 微观细节
• 整体摄影连贯性

这个阶段被调整为产生感觉的图像更自然地“烘焙”，更少合成，特别是在使用摄影 LoRA 时。

中间阶段——细节稳定

在两次传递之间，工作流程应用轻量化×1.5高档舞台.

这一步改进了细节连续性、边缘稳定性和特征连贯性在细化阶段之前，不会显着增加渲染时间。

🧠 新模型集成

ZIT_Gamma 现在使用超越现实 Z 图像模型作为其主要基础模型。

Hugging Face 在此处托管模型：
https://huggingface.co/Nurburgring/BEYOND_REALITY_Z_IMAGE

该模型已被证明是特别适合摄影，提供：

• 出色的面部真实感
• 自然的皮肤微观纹理
• 强光响应
• 提高摄影深度

与 ZIT 管道相结合，它产生极具说服力的社论和生活方式图像。

⚙️ 技术亮点

✓ 重新设计的采样架构

两者都第一次和第二次采样策略已更新以改进：

• 结构一致性
• LoRA 兼容性
• 细节稳定性
• 渲染可靠性

新配置产生更清晰的结果和更少的伪影，特别是在复杂的场景中。

✓ 简化的工作流程结构

的修复系统已被删除在此版本中保留工作流程：

• 更快
• 打火机
• 更容易操作

此版本完全专注于生成质量和摄影输出。

✓ 模块化通行证系统

每个渲染通道仍然可以独立启用或禁用，允许工作流程适应不同的需求：

• 仅第一遍→ 快速构思和绘制草图
• 全二程管道→ 电影或编辑最终渲染

✓ 先升级后精炼的管道

的×1.5高档舞台通道之间的优化可提高细化前的细节密度和特征稳定性。

这种方法始终如一地产生更好的微观细节和更有凝聚力的结果与按原始分辨率精炼相比。

✓ IMG2IMG 降噪灵活性

ZIT 对噪声值保持高度容忍。

对于IMG2IMG，降噪值可以安全达到0.75同时保留整体结构。

✓ 表现力细化通行证

第二遍调整为在保持连贯性的同时进行创造性的重新诠释.

推荐范围：

• 0.6 – 0.8 降噪

甜蜜点：

• 0.7→ 更丰富的纹理，更好的细节烘焙，更强的视觉特征。

✓ 干净的界面

工作流程使用：

• 模式选择器
• 降噪滑块
• 高档控制装置
• 简单的切换
• 子图以减少节点混乱

这样就保留了界面清晰且适合初学者，同时仍然提供高级用户所需的灵活性。

🛠️ Desaign’s Z-Image Turbo Workflow — ZIT_Gamma Release

TheDesaign ZIT_Gamma releaseintroduces the newest evolution of our Z-Image Turbo workflow, designed to pushphotographic realism, coherence, and rendering stabilityeven further while maintaining the simplicity and speed that define the ZIT pipeline.

This version integratesa redesigned sampling strategy, an updated rendering architecture, and a new base model, making ZIT_Gamma the most refined and photography-focused release of the workflow so far.

The workflow remainsfast, clean, coherent, and reliable, while still being extremely simple to operate. It works equally well forquick explorative generations, editorial photography, cinematic imagery, and high-quality visual production.

🔄 Overview

DesaignZIT_Gammais organized aroundtwo main rendering passes.

1. First Pass — Generation (TXT2IMG / IMG2IMG)

The first pass acts as the creative foundation of the image.

You can either:

• Generate directly from text (TXT2IMG)
• Transform an existing image while preserving structure (IMG2IMG)

In this version, thesampling strategy of the first pass has been redesignedto provide stronger global composition, more stable anatomy, and improved LoRA compatibility.

2. Second Pass — Refinement

The second pass performs acontrolled reinterpretation of the image, reinforcing:

• texture density
• lighting realism
• micro-details
• overall photographic coherence

This stage is tuned to produce images that feelmore naturally “baked” and less synthetic, particularly when working with photographic LoRAs.

Intermediate Stage — Detail Stabilization

Between both passes, the workflow applies alightweight ×1.5 upscale stage.

This step improvesdetail continuity, edge stability, and feature coherencebefore the refinement stage without significantly increasing render time.

🧠 New Model Integration

ZIT_Gamma now uses theBEYOND REALITY Z-Image modelas its primary base model.

Hugging Face hosts the model here:
https://huggingface.co/Nurburgring/BEYOND_REALITY_Z_IMAGE

This model has proven to beparticularly strong for photography, offering:

• excellent facial realism
• natural skin micro-texture
• strong lighting response
• improved photographic depth

Combined with the ZIT pipeline, it producesextremely convincing editorial and lifestyle imagery.

⚙️ Technical Highlights

✓ Redesigned Sampling Architecture

Both thefirst and second pass sampling strategieshave been updated to improve:

• structural consistency
• LoRA compatibility
• detail stability
• rendering reliability

The new configuration producescleaner results with fewer artifacts, particularly in complex scenes.

✓ Simplified Workflow Structure

Theinpainting system has been removedin this version to keep the workflow:

• faster
• lighter
• easier to operate

This release focuses entirely ongeneration quality and photographic output.

✓ Modular Pass System

Each rendering pass can still beenabled or disabled independently, allowing the workflow to adapt to different needs:

• First pass only→ fast ideation and sketching
• Full two-pass pipeline→ cinematic or editorial final renders

✓ Upscale-Before-Refine Pipeline

The×1.5 upscale stagebetween passes improves detail density and feature stability before refinement.

This approach consistently producesbetter micro-detail and more cohesive resultscompared to refining at the original resolution.

✓ IMG2IMG Denoise Flexibility

ZIT remains highly tolerant to denoise values.

ForIMG2IMG, denoise values can safely reach0.75while preserving overall structure.

✓ Expressive Refinement Pass

The second pass is tuned forcreative reinterpretation while maintaining coherence.

Recommended range:

• 0.6 – 0.8 denoise

Sweet spot:

• 0.7→ richer textures, better detail baking, and stronger visual character.

✓ Clean Interface

The workflow uses:

• mode selectors
• denoise sliders
• upscale controls
• simple toggles
• subgraphs to reduce node clutter

This keeps the interfaceclear and beginner-friendly, while still offering the flexibility needed by advanced users.
